name: arc-lens
description: A real-time PyTorch training dashboard and automated recovery controller built for the ARC framework, featuring weight rollbacks, learning rate adaptation, and AI failure diagnostics.

arcAgent.pythonPath.description: Path to the Python interpreter to use (e.g. /home/user/.venv/bin/python). Cannot be set by workspace settings — this value is executed, and a cloned repo's .vscode/settings.json must not be able to silently point it at an arbitrary binary.

arcAgent.stepDelay.description: Artificial delay (in seconds) added after each training step. Default 0 — this exists only for slowing a fast demo down enough to watch, and any non-zero value is real GPU time being thrown away.

arcAgent.gpuHourlyRate.description: Your GPU's cost per hour, used for the compute-savings figure in the dashboard. Leave at 0 to have ARC estimate it from the detected device; set it to your actual rate for an accurate number.

arcAgent.openRouterKey.description: API key for the AI features. The provider is detected from the prefix: sk-or-… (OpenRouter), gsk_… (Groq), sk-ant-… (Anthropic), AIzaSy… (Google), sk-… (OpenAI). Not workspace-overridable: a cloned repo's .vscode/settings.json must not be able to redirect your API key or the telemetry sent with it.

arcAgent.llmModel.description: [Pro] OpenRouter model string to use for AI features.

arcAgent.maxCheckpointMB.description: Maximum host RAM (in MB) the checkpoint ring buffer may use during a run. Oldest snapshots are pruned first when a new checkpoint would exceed this.
